title: Hyperparameter Transfer in Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2607.05017v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The performance of deep learning models crucially depends on the settings of hyperparameters like learning rate, initialization scale, and weight decay. Hyperparameter transfer aims to make near-optimal hyperparameter settings consistent across model scale, so that large models can be optimized by proxy tuning their smaller, cheaper-to-optimize counterparts. While transfer principles are well-studied in the context of dense neural networks in language and vision tasks, they remain comparatively under-explored for graph neural networks (GNNs). We develop and validate a transfer parameterization for GNNs trained with SGD, Adam, and AdamW. Through theoretical scaling analyses and controlled experiments, we show that the proposed parameterization yields stable feature updates, learning rate transfer, and improved performance as width and depth increase. translated_title: 图神经网络中的超参数迁移
translated_abstract: 深度学习模型的性能在很大程度上取决于学习率、初始化尺度和权重衰减等超参数的设置。超参数迁移旨在使接近最优的超参数设置在不同模型规模之间保持一致，从而可以通过代理调优较小、优化成本更低的对等模型来优化大模型。虽然迁移原则在语言和视觉任务中的密集神经网络背景下已被充分研究，但对于图神经网络（GNN）而言，这一领域仍相对缺乏探索。我们为使用SGD、Adam和AdamW训练的GNN开发并验证了一种迁移参数化方法。通过理论缩放分析和受控实验，我们表明所提出的参数化方法能够产生稳定的特征更新、学习率迁移，并随着宽度和深度的增加而提升性能。对于SGD，我们识别出依赖于图的第一层校正因子，并显示…
tldr: 本文为使用SGD、Adam和AdamW训练的图神经网络提出并验证了一种超参数迁移参数化方法，使模型在宽度和深度增加时能够实现稳定的特征更新、学习率迁移及性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper develops and validates a hyperparameter transfer parameterization for GNNs trained with SGD, Adam, and AdamW, enabling stable feature updates, learning rate transfer, and improved performance as width and depth increase.
